pages.text: $(#ad03fc)Spiritfire$() is a special type of fire that exists mostly in $(#ad03fc)The Other Place$()$(br)and does not harm living beings. Its special properties allow to use it to purify and convert$(br)certain materials by burning them, without consuming $()
Throw $(item)Demon's Dream Fruit$() to the ground and light it on fire with $(item)flint and steel$().$(br)

The main uses of $(item)Spiritfire$() are to convert $(item)diamond$() into $(item)Spirit Attuned Gem$(),$(br)to get basic ingredients such as $(item)Otherstone$() and $(item)Otherworld Saplings$(),$(br)and to purify impure chalks.$(br)
An easier way to obtain $(item)Otherstone$() than via divination.$(br)
Otherrock is a variation of $(item)Otherstone$(),$(br) you can use it for decoration and making sacrificial bowls,$(br)  but it does not work as a base for chalks or dimensional storage.$(br)
An easier way to clone any dye, mix this flower and the target color. You can also make ~~suspicious~~ delicious stews.$(br)
